name: fn-browser
description: Browser automation MCP for Claude: MV3 Chrome extension + Bun native-messaging host. Standalone distribution of the fntune monorepo's browser stack.

scripts.build: bun run --cwd packages/utils build && bun run --cwd packages/log build && bun run --cwd packages/browser build && bun run --cwd apps/chrome-extension build && bun run --cwd apps/native-host build
scripts.test: bun run --cwd packages/log test && bun run --cwd packages/browser test && bun run --cwd apps/native-host test
scripts.typecheck: bun run --cwd packages/utils typecheck && bun run --cwd packages/log typecheck && bun run --cwd packages/browser typecheck && bun run --cwd apps/chrome-extension typecheck && bun run --cwd apps/native-host typecheck
scripts.ci: bun run build && bun run typecheck && bun run lint && bun run test
